parsed.answer: As of August 22, Mara’s August 15 delivery choice remains in force, but the supplied evidence does not identify the delivery mode. For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8 (REPLAY-0-632). The retry policy is RETRY-0-907, superseding RETRY-0-108.
